ab.d: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model with this ability is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

At the start of your Command phase, you can select one **combat doctrine** listed below. If you do, that **combat doctrine** is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make an **advance move**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINEThis unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make a **fall-back move**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent this unit from being **eligible to shoot** and **eligible to declare a charge**.
Unless otherwise stated:

• You can only select each **combat doctrine** once per battle.
• Only one **combat doctrine** can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a **combat doctrine** active for a unit, any **combat doctrine** previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

ab.name: Drive Home the Blade
ab.description: Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to shoot, if one or more models from that unit are within 1" of an open Hatchway and every model in that unit is on the same side of that Hatchway, select one enemy unit on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [sustained hits 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

ab.name: Relentless Salvoes
ab.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

ab.name: Sacred Oath
ab.description: Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, when you select a target for Oath of Moment, you can use this Detachment rule. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

ab.name: Focused Response
ab.description:
• Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
• Each time an enemy unit makes an attack that targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is Set To Defend, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

stratagems.t: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.t: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against **mortal wounds**.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit has shot.
stratagems.fx: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

• +1 **BS**.
• +1 **AP**.

stratagems.t: Shield of the Void – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.

stratagems.t: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".

stratagems.t: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.
stratagems.rs: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.

stratagems.t: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes mounted unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx:
• If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
• Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit is selected to make an advance move.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.
stratagems.fx: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.fx: Attacks that target your unit have -1 **AP** until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.
stratagems.fx:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is **suppressed** until the start of your next turn:

• While a unit is **suppressed**, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

• Up to D6".
• Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.fx: When making that **consolidation move**, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s attacks have:

• [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
• Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.tg: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have:

• [Close-Quarters].
• [Ignores Cover].

stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has +1 **OC** until the end of the turn.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s attacks have:

• [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
• Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One Terminator Squad unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

stratagems.when: Start or end of any phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.rs: Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability, ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways).
stratagems.rs: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One Terminator Assault Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
stratagems.rs: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit.
stratagems.fx: Attacks that target your unit have -1 **D** until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

• [Lethal Hits].
• [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit.
stratagems.fx: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.when: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain/Judiciar unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.fx:
• Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll **hit rolls** of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.
stratagems.fx: When making that **pile-in**/**consolidation move**, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.
stratagems.fx: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:

• **BS** and **WS**.
• Hit rolls.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Deathwing/Ravenwing unit within range of an objective is destroyed.
stratagems.tg: That DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.
stratagems.fx:
Select one **objective**:

• That no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) are within range of.
• That your unit was controlling at the end of the previous phase.That **objective** is secured.

stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Ravenwing unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has Mobile.
